title: ageratina espinosarum
intro: Ageratina espinosarum, commonly known as Emetic Root or Ruta Maya, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, nausea, and vomiting. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina espinosarum include emetic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for relieving stomach discomfort and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents present in Ageratina espinosarum include iridoid glycosides, such as ageratin and espinoside, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
